questions: Q1: What CLI files need PLAY updates?
Q2: Should EXECUTE be removed or PLAY added alongside?
Q3: What is the deploy ordering requirement?

answers.answer: Three files need updates: (1) src/tickets/create.ts — VALID_MODES array (line 13) and help text (line 17), (2) src/tickets/index.ts — usage text (line 21) and help text (line 73), (3) src/docs/cli-content.ts — mode table (line 109), example (line 247), and mode description (line 250). The mode validation logic normalizes to uppercase and checks inclusion — no structural change needed.
evidence: create.ts lines 79-87: Mode validation normalizes to uppercase + inclusion check
index.ts lines 21, 73: Help text references modes in 2 locations
cli-content.ts lines 109, 247, 250: Mode docs in 3 locations

answers.answer: Replace EXECUTE with PLAY in VALID_MODES and all help text. The CLI is a thin client — users should see PLAY not EXECUTE. Since EXECUTE has zero production usage, no backward compatibility concern exists. The server is the authoritative gatekeeper for platform enforcement. If backward compat is desired for scripts, both could coexist, but the simpler approach is clean replacement.
evidence: Production DB: EXECUTE has 0 tickets — no existing scripts depend on --mode EXECUTE
create.ts line 147: mode sent in POST body — server validates against allowedModes

answers.answer: Server must deploy first. If CLI sends mode:'PLAY' before the server recognizes PLAY in platformConfig.allowedModes, the server returns 400. With server deployed first, CLI sending PLAY works immediately.
evidence: ticket-controller.ts lines 152-154: server validates mode against platformConfig.allowedModes
create.ts line 147: mode sent in POST body

statement: CLI needs a 3-file change: replace EXECUTE with PLAY in VALID_MODES (create.ts), help text (create.ts, index.ts), and docs (cli-content.ts). This is the smallest change surface of all repos. Deploy server first to avoid 400 rejections. No play-specific subcommands needed at MVP-1. Future levels may add play-specific commands (hlx plays list/preview/run).
